title: Lily and Her Cat
text:
Lily has a cat. The cat is white and small. Her name is Milo. Lily feeds Milo every morning. Milo sleeps on Lily's bed at night.

Milo needs water too. Lily cleans his box every day. She takes Milo to the vet once a year. The vet checks his teeth and his ears. Lily loves her cat very much.

questions.text: How often does Lily take Milo to the vet?
Where does Milo probably feel safe at night?
How does Lily feel about Milo?

vocabulary.definition: gives food to a person or an animal
a clear liquid that people and animals need to drink
the hard white parts in the mouth used for biting and chewing

paragraph_translations: Lily'nin bir kedisi var. Kedi beyaz ve küçük. Adı Milo. Lily her sabah Milo'yu besler. Milo geceleri Lily'nin yatağında uyur.
Milo'nun da suya ihtiyacı var. Lily her gün onun kumluğunu temizler. Milo'yu yılda bir kez veterinere götürür. Veteriner onun dişlerini ve kulaklarını kontrol eder. Lily kedisini çok sever.
